### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Claude AI discovers novel CRISPR-like enzyme system in viruses
Anthropic's Claude AI identified a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system significantly faster than traditional research methods would typically achieve.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Enzyme system features DNA repeats resembling CRISPR technology</li>
<li>Discovery made by Claude AI system</li>
<li>Comparison to CRISPR gene-editing platform noted</li>
<li>950 Claude agents identified ~200,000 genes, narrowed to 20 candidates in 21 hours; estimated weeks-to-months for human experts</li>
<li>ART system found in bacteriophages: reverse transcriptase, non-coding DNA repeat arrays, accessory protein of unknown function</li>
<li>Exhibits CRISPR-like properties; could perform DNA cutting, copying, pasting operations</li>
<li>Feng Zhang (CRISPR pioneer, MIT) called finding &#x27;genuinely intriguing&#x27;; Stanford researchers independently described comparable distinct system</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic Accelerates Claude Performance 3x on Web and Desktop
Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7, delivering a 13% improvement on coding benchmarks with substantially better vision capabilities for higher-resolution image processing. The model shows improved performance on complex, long-running tasks and maintains precise instruction adherence across benchmarks. Pricing remains unchanged, and new cybersecurity safeguards automatically detect and block high-risk requests.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>13% improvement on 93-task coding benchmark versus Opus 4.6</li>
<li>Substantially better vision capabilities for higher-resolution image processing</li>
<li>Pricing unchanged: $5/million input tokens, $25/million output tokens</li>
<li>New Cyber Verification Program available for security professionals conducting legitimate testing</li>
</ul>
